title: Experience scene file
description: Composition plan for one runtime Scene: its Shots, their Beats, and the narrative Segment ids each Beat carries. Holds no visible text and no localized strings; text is fetched from text/locales/<locale>/ by segment id at runtime. See docs/text-experience-binding.md.

id.description: Scene id, unique across the story.

devLabel.description: Development and debug label only. ASCII, never shown to a visitor, never translated.

chapter.description: Chapter whose segments this scene draws from. A scene may cross story-section boundaries within that chapter.

shots.description: Shots in progression order. A Shot is one way of presenting part of the Scene; see docs/scene-shot-model.md.

id.description: Shot id, unique within the scene.

beats.description: Beats in progression order. A Beat is a timing unit; it may carry several segments, one, or none.

id.description: Beat id, unique within the scene.

segments.description: Segment ids from the chapter structure, in reading order. An empty array is valid: a beat may be pure staging with no text.
